lines: Kyeh-heh-heh-heh, what kind of unfounded nonsense is that!!?
But... are you sure about this, kid? If you go that far, those are fighting words in the Oni world.
A deadly aura so strong that it was almost pricking our skin was erupting from the female mercenary's entire body.
Th-That's right, Fuma-chan!! What are you saying all of a sudden!?
Aieeeee!!! A-Apologize, Fuma! We're so sorry, this guy's a little weird!!
Shikanosuke took the initiative and began apologizing to Yamata no Orochi, bowing repeatedly.
Hm-hm... No point apologizing now. Even I believe in something called "trust."
Maybe you're just trying to find some fault in me, virtuous me, so you can dock my pay, Fuma kid?
I wouldn't do something like that. Actually, I'm more worried about you stabbing me in the back.
Ohh? You've got some guts to say that―
Yamata no Orochi crept toward us slowly.
But before she could make any concrete moves, Sago-san stepped in between.
Calm down, both of you. ―Young Lord, you must have good reasons for going so far as to say that, right?
―Yes, there's proof. But I'm not the one who has it. My "collaborator" does.
The female warrior scoffed intensely, and Sago-san could not hide his bewilderment.
Young Lord...? You're not talking about me or the other two, are you?
We don't know anything. But there's no one else you could call your collaborator―
I grinned and nodded to Sago-san.
The hint was the food repeatedly disappearing throughout the mission.
Someone had stealthily been pilfering those when no one could see.
―Come on out, Sakura!! Show them the "proof!"
Heyyyy! Greetings everyone～. It's Sakura-chan, the collaborator～☆
Someone jumped out of the shadow at my feet.
It was the freeloader living in the Fuma mansion―young Sakura, the Shadow Art user.
Whaaaaaa!!? Why were you in Fuma's shadow!?
I had also been shocked when I had first realized it.
Sakura has... apparently been hiding in my shadow and tagging along to kill time.
Nyahaha～ I mean, I couldn't find a part-time job at all and I was really bored♪
The Shadow Art user Sakura's specialty was the Ninja Art allowing her to enter others' shadows and travel within them.
Sakura had used her Shadow Art to enter my shadow―cat napping and occasionally nabbing cookies.
Yeah. Even when we were chased by Hestia, she was apparently sleeping like a baby.
Sakura stuck out her tongue and looked embarrassed.
A-Anyways... this also gave us an opportunity.
There was someone lying low that nobody knew about and who could move about freely. It was huge.
I had my suspicions about Yamata no Orochi and asked Sakura to spy on her. The result of that is―Sakura?
Okey dokey!! ―Ta-da～♪ It's this communication device!
Sakura pulled a medium-sized communication device out of her pocket.
This... was the "proof" that we had found.
Sakura had stolen this communication device from Yamata no Orochi's bag during the confusion while we were breaking through the gate of Yomihara.
It was a special device that could even be used underground in Yomihara.
I took a look at it when I went to have a leak a bit earlier. And... you were in contact with a government official, weren't you?
It looks like you demanded triple your original compensation in exchange for giving them Sago-san, no?
Using the device, I had also briefly talked to the government official.
Hm-hm... So what about it? It was just a negotiation for higher pay.
Right, if only that was all there was to it. But you've also already reported that we, the Taimanin, were killed by the UFS.
Killed―? But Heberybody is still alive and well.
That's... because she was planning to take care of that afterwards.
She was going to eliminate us closer to the surface where it was safe and take Sago-san from us.
And then she would negotiate with the government official for a higher payment again―.
Hm-hm... Kyeh-heh-heh-heh!! You really got me.
Suddenly, Yamata no Orochi let a maniacal laugh ring out.
Well, I can't help it... I've never been good at elaborate tricks like this.
Yes. You really are a clever kid. I might even fall for you, hm-hm...
Why did you hire those Trolls and have them attack our hideout?
I asked, not responding to her flippant remark.
Shizuru is tough, you know. That's why I wanted only you kids to go with me.
She had done it to keep the highly-trained Shizuru at the hideout and move forward with us.
Why? Why did you set us up?
For drinking money, of course. I'm having a hard time paying my tab this month.
But actually, maybe this weirdness was exactly what it meant to be a resident of Yomihara.
So, are you done with your questions? My plan was foiled, but that doesn't change what I'm going to do...
I will kill you kids and steal that broken piece of junk. Then I'll negotiate with that stupid government official for more money―and that will make me very happy♪
What the what～? I pop out and all of a sudden we're in big trouble!?
Aieeee!!?? Really? Ms. Yamata no Orochi was really a baddie!!?
Yeah!! And her power is no joke! Everyone, follow my orders!
He can't fight with that body. We'll have him take cover behind us!!
―Young Lord. You don't have to risk your lives for the likes of me. If anything goes wrong, just leave me―
―Quiet. I'll never abandon even a single Fuma ninja.
Hm-hm-hm!! You're so fired up, kid!! Bring that passion when you're pleading for mercy in hell!!!
The power of the mythically strong Oni began to surge.
Yamata no Orochi raised her giant, freakish sword and lunged toward us.
